## Title
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana

## Agricultural Domain
Schemes

Central

## Scheme ID
pmfby

## Scheme Introduction
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) was launched from Kharif 2016 with aim to support production in agriculture by providing an affordable crop insurance product to ensure comprehensive risk cover for crops of farmers against all non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest stage. The Scheme has completed 16 crop seasons and is being implemented across States/Union Territories (UTs). Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) is a Central Sector Scheme that aims to: Providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage arising out of unforeseen events. Stabilizing the income of farmers to ensure their continuance in farming. Encouraging farmers to adopt innovative and modern agricultural practices. Ensuring credit worthiness of the farmers, crop diversification and enhancing growth and competitiveness of agriculture sector besides protecting the farmers from production risks. Promoting innovation & research of insurance and allied products so-as-to offer expanded choice to the farmers and the State Governments/UT Administrations.

## Scheme Benefits
The scheme ensures comprehensive risk coverage and promotes digitization and transparency in operations. Covers prevented sowing, standing crop losses (yield loss), mid-season adversity, post-harvest losses, and localized calamities. Farmers pay a uniform premium: 2% (Kharif), 1.5% (Rabi), 5% (commercial/horticulture crops); balance premium is shared by the Government. Benefits include Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into farmers' bank accounts and use of technology (e.g., satellites, remote sensing) for transparent assessments. Implementation is through a single national IT platform: National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP).

## Scheme Eligibility
All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing the notified crops in the notified areas are eligible for coverage. Farmers should have insurable interest on the insured crops and lands and are required to submit necessary documentary evidence of land records prevailing in the State (Records of Right (RoR), Land Possession Certificate (LPC) etc.) and/or applicable contract/agreement details. Tribal farmers and forest dwellers having cultivation in forest land under FRA are also allowed to be insured under the scheme. The farmers cultivating community owned land especially as is practiced in NER states are also allowed to be covered under the scheme with certification from village head or revenue authorities. All farmers are required to essentially submit Aadhaar Number and declaration about the crop sown/crops intended to be sown. The scheme is optional for all farmers including farmers who have been sanctioned short-term Seasonal Agricultural Operations (SAO) loans through Kisan Credit Card (KCC) for the notified crops. Existing Loanee farmers who do not want to get covered under the scheme have the option of opting-out by submitting requisite declaration to loan sanctioning bank branches at least seven days prior to the cut-off date for enrolment. Special efforts shall be made to ensure maximum coverage of Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST)/Women farmers under the Scheme. Coverage of Crops includes: Food crops (Cereals, Millets and Pulses), Oilseeds, Annual Commercial/Annual Horticultural crops. Pilots for coverage can be taken up for perennial horticultural/commercial crops for which standard methodology for yield estimation or correlation between weather condition and yield/output is available.

Under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY), a multi-tiered and structured Grievance Redressal Mechanism (GRM) has been established to ensure that farmers' grievances are addressed in a time-bound, transparent, and effective manner. દૂધ આપતાં પશુઓ માટે આહાર સંતુલિત હોવો જોઈએ — દાણો, લીલો ચારો, સુકો ચારો અને સ્વચ્છ પાણી નિયમિત આપવું જોઈએ, અને આહાર સ્થાનિક ઉપલબ્ધ ઘટકો પરથી સસ્તામાં બનાવવાનો પ્રયાસ કરવો જોઈએ. દૂધ ઉત્પાદન અને પ્રજનન સારું રહે તે માટે પશુને મિનરલ મિક્સર પણ આપવું જોઈએ; દાણા અને ચારો સૂકા, ઠંડા સ્થળે સંગ્રહવો જેથી ફૂગ ન લાગે.

turns.text: अमरावती में पीएम-किसान के लिए पात्रता क्या है?

**कौन पात्र है:**
- किसान परिवार में पति, पत्नी और नाबालिग बच्चे शामिल होते हैं।
- परिवार के पास राज्य/केंद्र शासित प्रदेश के भूमि रिकॉर्ड के अनुसार खेती योग्य भूमि होनी चाहिए।
- एक परिवार में केवल 1 सदस्य को लाभ मिलता है।
- 01.02.2019 की भूमि-स्वामित्व स्थिति के आधार पर पात्रता तय होती है।
- 01.02.2019 के बाद मृत्यु होने पर विरासत से भूमि मिलने वाले उत्तराधिकारी पात्र रह सकते हैं।
- भूमि का रिकॉर्ड पीएम-किसान पोर्टल पर दर्ज होना चाहिए।
- आधार से जुड़ा सक्रिय बैंक खाता होना चाहिए।
- ई-केवाईसी पूरा होना चाहिए।

**कौन पात्र नहीं है:**
- संस्थागत भूमि-स्वामी।
- वर्तमान या पूर्व सांसद, विधायक, मंत्री, मेयर, जिला पंचायत अध्यक्ष और संवैधानिक पद धारक परिवार, ग्राम प्रधान को छोड़कर।
- सेवारत या सेवानिवृत्त सरकारी कर्मचारी, वर्ग 4/ग्रुप D/MTS को छोड़कर।
- ₹10,000 या उससे अधिक मासिक पेंशन पाने वाले, कुछ छूट प्राप्त वर्गों को छोड़कर।
- आयकर देने वाले।
- डॉक्टर, इंजीनियर, वकील, चार्टर्ड अकाउंटेंट और आर्किटेक्ट जैसे पेशेवर।
- अनिवासी भारतीय।

## Scheme Introduction
Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector Scheme that provides income support to all cultivable landholding farmer families in India to meet expenses related to agricultural inputs, allied activities, and domestic needs. Under the scheme, eligible farmer families receive financial assistance of ₹6,000 per year, paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each, disbursed every four months during April–July, August–November, and December–March.

## Scheme Benefits
The PM-KISAN scheme aims to supplement the financial needs of landholding farmer families for agricultural inputs, crop health, improved yields, and domestic expenses. Under the scheme, ₹6,000 per year is released by the Central Government directly into eligible farmers' Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), subject to specified exclusion criteria. It is an entitlement-based scheme, and beneficiaries are identified and verified by respective States and Union Territories as per operational guidelines. Farmer details are maintained by States/UTs and uploaded to the PM-KISAN Portal (https://pmkisan.gov.in), supported by a dedicated mobile application to assist farmers. Essential beneficiary details include location information, Aadhaar, personal details, and contact information, along with land records such as Khasra number, Khata number, land area, ownership status, and mutation details. Aadhaar is mandatory for registration and benefit transfer. Funds are transferred through DBT using the PFMS portal via accredited and sponsoring banks to destination bank accounts, which may include Scheduled Banks, Post Offices, Rural Banks, Cooperative Banks, or other RBI- and PFMS-approved financial institutions.

## Scheme Eligibility
Under the PM-KISAN scheme, eligibility is limited to farmer families comprising husband, wife, and minor children who own cultivable land as per State/UT land records, with only one eligible member per family. Eligibility is determined based on land ownership as of 01.02.2019, with continued eligibility allowed only in cases of inheritance due to death after this date; purchasers or transferees (other than by inheritance) are not eligible. Exclusions include institutional landholders; families of current or former MPs, MLAs, Ministers, Mayors, District Panchayat Chairpersons, and Constitutional Post Holders (except Gram Pradhans); serving or retired government employees (except Class IV/Group D/MTS); pensioners receiving ₹10,000 or more per month (except specified exempted categories); income tax payees meeting prescribed criteria; practicing professionals such as doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs, and architects; and NRIs. Mandatory requirements include land seeding on the PM-KISAN portal, Aadhaar-linked active bank accounts for DBT, and completion of e-KYC. Land seeding is exempted in 14 specified States/UTs due to land record status, under the Vibrant Villages Programme, and for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs). The scheme has progressively integrated digital infrastructure such as PFMS, UIDAI (Aadhaar), Income Tax and pension databases, NPCI, NTRP, NFSA, Aadhaar Payment Bridge, facial authentication-based e-KYC, Kisan-eMitra chatbot, cloud migration, mandatory unique mobile numbers, and integration with State Farmer Registries for real-time verification. Additionally, States/UTs conduct annual physical verification of 5% of beneficiaries to ensure eligibility and transparency.

The PM-KISAN scheme has a stratified review and monitoring mechanism at the National, State, and District levels. At the National level, the Review Committee is headed by the Cabinet Secretary, while States notify State and District Level Review Monitoring Committee

- 01.02.2019 की भूमि-स्वामित्व स्थिति के आधार पर पात्रता तय होती है।

- ई-केवाईसी पूरा होना चाहिए।

- संस्थागत भूमि-स्वामी।
- वर्तमान या पूर्व सांसद, विधायक, मंत्री, मेयर, जिला पंचायत अध्यक्ष और संवैधानिक पद धारक परिवार, ग्राम प्रधान को छोड़कर।
- सेवारत या सेवानिवृत्त सरकारी कर्मचारी, वर्ग 4/ग्रुप D/MTS को छोड़कर।
- ₹10,000 या उससे अधिक मासिक पेंशन पाने वाले, कुछ छूट प्राप्त वर्गों को छोड़कर।
- आयकर देने वाले।
- डॉक्टर, इंजीनियर, वकील, चार्टर्ड अकाउंटेंट और आर्किटेक्ट जैसे पेशेवर।

## Title
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana

## Agricultural Domain
Schemes

## Scope
Central

## Scheme ID
pmfby

## Scheme Introduction
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) was launched from Kharif 2016 with aim to support production in agriculture by providing an affordable crop insurance product to ensure comprehensive risk cover for crops of farmers against all non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest stage. The Scheme has completed 16 crop seasons and is being implemented across States/Union Territories (UTs). Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) is a Central Sector Scheme that aims to: Providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage arising out of unforeseen events. Stabilizing the income of farmers to ensure their continuance in farming. Encouraging farmers to adopt innovative and modern agricultural practices. Ensuring credit worthiness of the farmers, crop diversification and enhancing growth and competitiveness of agriculture sector besides protecting the farmers from production risks. Promoting innovation & research of insurance and allied products so-as-to offer expanded choice to the farmers and the State Governments/UT Administrations.

## Scheme Benefits
The scheme ensures comprehensive risk coverage and promotes digitization and transparency in operations. Covers prevented sowing, standing crop losses (yield loss), mid-season adversity, post-harvest losses, and localized calamities. Farmers pay a uniform premium: 2% (Kharif), 1.5% (Rabi), 5% (commercial/horticulture crops); balance premium is shared by the Government. Benefits include Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into farmers' bank accounts and use of technology (e.g., satellites, remote sensing) for transparent assessments. Implementation is through a single national IT platform: National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP).

## Scheme Eligibility
All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing the notified crops in the notified areas are eligible for coverage. Farmers should have insurable interest on the insured crops and lands and are required to submit necessary documentary evidence of land records prevailing in the State (Records of Right (RoR), Land Possession Certificate (LPC) etc.) and/or applicable contract/agreement details. Tribal farmers and forest dwellers having cultivation in forest land under FRA are also allowed to be insured under the scheme. The farmers cultivating community owned land especially as is practiced in NER states are also allowed to be covered under the scheme with certification from village head or revenue authorities. All farmers are required to essentially submit Aadhaar Number and declaration about the crop sown/crops intended to be sown. The scheme is optional for all farmers including farmers who have been sanctioned short-term Seasonal Agricultural Operations (SAO) loans through Kisan Credit Card (KCC) for the notified crops. Existing Loanee farmers who do not want to get covered under the scheme have the option of opting-out by submitting requisite declaration to loan sanctioning bank branches at least seven days prior to the cut-off date for enrolment. Special efforts shall be made to ensure maximum coverage of Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST)/Women farmers under the Scheme. Coverage of Crops includes: Food crops (Cereals, Millets and Pulses), Oilseeds, Annual Commercial/Annual Horticultural crops. Pilots for coverage can be taken up for perennial horticultural/commercial crops for which standard methodology for yield estimation or correlation between weather condition and yield/output is available.

## Scheme Support
Under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY), a multi-tiered and structured Grievance Redressal Mechanism (GRM) has been established to ensure that farmers' grievances are addressed in a time-bound, transparent, and effective manner. turns.text: ചന്ദ്രാപൂർ ജില്ലയിൽ പാടത്തിന് ഫോസ്ഫറസ് എപ്പോൾ പ്രയോഗിക്കണം?

പാടത്തിൽ ഫോസ്ഫറസ് സാധാരണയായി **നിലം ഒരുക്കുന്ന സമയത്ത്, അവസാന കുളിർചാട്ടം/കിളച്ചൽ ഘട്ടത്തിൽ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ നടീൽ സമയത്ത് ബേസൽ ആയി** പ്രയോഗിക്കണം; അരിയിൽ ഒരു ഉറവിടത്തിൽ **മുഴുവൻ ഫോസ്ഫറസും കുളിർചാട്ട സമയത്ത്** ചേർക്കണമെന്ന് പറയുന്നു. മുൻ വിളയായ ഗോതമ്പിന് ശുപാർശ ചെയ്ത ഫോസ്ഫറ്റിക് വളം നൽകിയിട്ടുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ അരിയിൽ ഫോസ്ഫറസ് ഒഴിവാക്കാമെന്നും, ഫോസ്ഫറസ് കുറവുള്ള നിലങ്ങളിൽ നടീൽ മുമ്പ് ബേസൽ ആയി നൽകാമെന്നും ഉറവിടം പറയുന്നു.

पीएम-किसानसाठी पात्रता अशी आहे:

**कोण पात्र आहे:**
- कुटुंबात पती, पत्नी आणि अल्पवयीन मुले असलेले, राज्य/केंद्रशासित प्रदेशाच्या जमिनीच्या नोंदींनुसार लागवडीयोग्य जमीन असलेले शेतकरी कुटुंब.
- एका कुटुंबात फक्त 1 सदस्य पात्र असतो.
- 01.02.2019 नंतर वारसाहक्काने जमीन मिळालेली असल्यास पात्रता सुरू राहू शकते.

**कोण पात्र नाही:**
- संस्थात्मक जमीनधारक.
- सध्याचे किंवा माजी खासदार, आमदार, मंत्री, महापौर, जिल्हा पंचायत अध्यक्ष आणि संवैधानिक पदधारक; ग्रामप्रधान याला अपवाद.
- सेवा बजावणारे किंवा निवृत्त सरकारी कर्मचारी; वर्ग IV / ग्रुप D / MTS यांना अपवाद.
- दरमहा ₹10,000 किंवा अधिक पेन्शन घेणारे; काही सूट दिलेल्या श्रेणी वगळता.
- आयकर भरणारे.
- डॉक्टर, अभियंता, वकील, सी.ए., आर्किटेक्ट यांसारखे व्यावसायिक.
- अनिवासी भारतीय.

**अतिरिक्त अटी:**
- पीएम-किसान पोर्टलवर जमीन नोंद असणे आवश्यक.
- आधारशी जोडलेले सक्रिय बँक खाते असणे आवश्यक.
- ई-केवायसी पूर्ण असणे आवश्यक.

## Title
PRADHAN MANTRI KISAN SAMMAN NIDHI SCHEME (PM-KISAN SCHEME)  OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES  

## Agricultural Domain
Schemes

## Scope
Central

## Scheme ID
pmkisan

## Scheme Introduction
Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector Scheme that provides income support to all cultivable landholding farmer families in India to meet expenses related to agricultural inputs, allied activities, and domestic needs. Under the scheme, eligible farmer families receive financial assistance of ₹6,000 per year, paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each, disbursed every four months during April–July, August–November, and December–March.

## Scheme Benefits
The PM-KISAN scheme aims to supplement the financial needs of landholding farmer families for agricultural inputs, crop health, improved yields, and domestic expenses. Under the scheme, ₹6,000 per year is released by the Central Government directly into eligible farmers' Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), subject to specified exclusion criteria. It is an entitlement-based scheme, and beneficiaries are identified and verified by respective States and Union Territories as per operational guidelines. Farmer details are maintained by States/UTs and uploaded to the PM-KISAN Portal (https://pmkisan.gov.in), supported by a dedicated mobile application to assist farmers. Essential beneficiary details include location information, Aadhaar, personal details, and contact information, along with land records such as Khasra number, Khata number, land area, ownership status, and mutation details. Aadhaar is mandatory for registration and benefit transfer. Funds are transferred through DBT using the PFMS portal via accredited and sponsoring banks to destination bank accounts, which may include Scheduled Banks, Post Offices, Rural Banks, Cooperative Banks, or other RBI- and PFMS-approved financial institutions.

## Scheme Eligibility
Under the PM-KISAN scheme, eligibility is limited to farmer families comprising husband, wife, and minor children who own cultivable land as per State/UT land records, with only one eligible member per family. Eligibility is determined based on land ownership as of 01.02.2019, with continued eligibility allowed only in cases of inheritance due to death after this date; purchasers or transferees (other than by inheritance) are not eligible. Exclusions include institutional landholders; families of current or former MPs, MLAs, Ministers, Mayors, District Panchayat Chairpersons, and Constitutional Post Holders (except Gram Pradhans); serving or retired government employees (except Class IV/Group D/MTS); pensioners receiving ₹10,000 or more per month (except specified exempted categories); income tax payees meeting prescribed criteria; practicing professionals such as doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs, and architects; and NRIs. Mandatory requirements include land seeding on the PM-KISAN portal, Aadhaar-linked active bank accounts for DBT, and completion of e-KYC. Land seeding is exempted in 14 specified States/UTs due to land record status, under the Vibrant Villages Programme, and for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs). The scheme has progressively integrated digital infrastructure such as PFMS, UIDAI (Aadhaar), Income Tax and pension databases, NPCI, NTRP, NFSA, Aadhaar Payment Bridge, facial authentication-based e-KYC, Kisan-eMitra chatbot, cloud migration, mandatory unique mobile numbers, and integration with State Farmer Registries for real-time verification. Additionally, States/UTs conduct annual physical verification of 5% of beneficiaries to ensure eligibility and transparency.

## Scheme Support
The PM-KISAN scheme has a stratified review and monitoring mechanism at the National, State, and District levels. At the National level, the Review Committee is headed by the Cabinet Secretary, while States notify State and District Level Review Monitoring Committee

turns.text: చంద్రాపూర్ జిల్లాలో అరటి పుష్పించే దశలో ఎలాంటి జాగ్రత్తలు తీసుకోవాలి?

అరటి పుష్పించే దశలో గెలపై భారం తగ్గేలా **డీ-నావెలింగ్** చేయాలి, అంటే మగ పుష్ప భాగాన్ని తొలగించాలి; అలాగే **7-10 రోజులకు ఒకసారి నీటిపారుదల** ఇవ్వాలి, కానీ నీరు నిల్వ ఉండకుండా చూసుకోవాలి.  
- **తీసుకోవాల్సిన జాగ్రత్తలు:**  
  - ఎండిపోయిన ఆకులు, అదనపు మొగ్గలను తొలగించండి.  
  - పుష్పించే మరియు గెల అభివృద్ధి దశలో క్రమంగా నీరు ఇవ్వండి.  
  - గెల నాణ్యత కోసం పుష్పించే/ప్రారంభ గెల దశలో **2% యూరియా + 1% పొటాష్ సల్ఫేట్** పిచికారీ ఉపయోగపడుతుంది.  
  - మైక్రోపోషక మిశ్రమాన్ని పంట 4-6 నెలల దశలో మరియు గెల ఏర్పడే సమయంలో పిచికారీ చేయవచ్చు.

Weed Management [खरपतवार प्रबंधन]: Hand weeding [निराई] after 10-15 days or pre-emergence [अंकुरण] herbicides [शाकनाशी] (like Butachlor) can be applied carefully depending on weed load.
Pest [कीट] and Disease Control [रोग नियंत्रण]: Monitor for early signs of blast [झुलसा], sheath blight [झुलसा], and stem borers. Use recommended insecticides [कीटनाशक]/fungicides [फफूंदनाशी दवाएँ] only when needed to avoid resistance. Use of Mat-Type Nursery [नर्सरी] (for Machine Transplanting [पुनः रोपाई]) is recommended. In areas using mechanical transplanters, mat-type nurseries are promoted using plastic trays or polythene sheets.

# WESTERN MAHARASHTRA (DESH REGION) & KHANDESH REGION
The Western Maharashtra (Desh region), comprising Pune, Satara, Sangli, Kolhapur, and Solapur districts & Khandesh region, comprising Nashik, Dhule, Ahmednagar, Jalgaon & Nandurbar Districts, Western Maharashtra receives moderate rainfall ranging from 500-900 mm annually. The soils here are predominantly black to medium black and well-drained, making them suitable for both field [खेत] and horticultural crops. Major crops grown in this region include cereals like sorghum [ज्वार] and wheat [गेहूं]; pulses such as chickpea [चना] and oilseeds like safflower [कुसुम] and linseed [अलसी].
